notes: The SP baseline reaches fatal VM_Call with NULL vm after map_restart 0. The independent probe terminates its own process after timeout.
The first retail SP trial attempts its initial save while the player is not yet alive; the longer completed comparison run writes all four saves.
The Holomatch Windows baseline and command-only build both hit STACK_OVERFLOW on reload. The baseline observation establishes that this predates the SP command correction.

The first Linux Holomatch client exits normally with four captures and three initializations; the script incorrectly expects its scheduled restart before its queued continuation. The separate timer probe ends its script after the request and observes a second local snapshot.
The first Windows build catches a mistaken variable name in the nextmap expression; corrected before runtime validation.

The first corrected storage probe uses /EHsc with a throwing C-declared error stub and fails during bounds rejection. /EHs corrects only that owned test harness, as described in Microsoft documentation.
